items.title: Scalable PDF Retrieval with Cohere Embed 5 and Qdrant Asymmetric Quantization
items.summary: Cohere released Embed 5, a family of embedding models. The family has a quality-focused model, Embed 5 Pro (embed-v5.0-pro), and a lighter one, Embed 5 Fast (embed-v5.0-fast). Both accept text and images, support 100+ languages, and share an embedding space.
items.creator: info@qdrant.tech (Andrey Vasnetsov)
